x: Firuz Tughlaq was the first to levy jizya on Brahmins, who had been exempt earlier.

s: The Horse-Shoe arch was first introduced in the -
x: The Alai Darwaza (1311) of Alauddin Khalji introduced the horse-shoe arch with a lotus-bud fringe, and has the first true dome. Balban's tomb has the first true arch, not the horse-shoe arch.

s: The first true arch in the Sultanate memorial could be seen in
x: Balban's tomb at Mehrauli shows the first true arch in India. The Alai Darwaza has the first true dome; Iltutmish's tomb and Quwwat-ul-Islam use corbelled (false) arches.

s: India’s first tomb constructed in the Indo-Islamic style was
x:
Most books and keys: Balban's tomb (first tomb in a true Indo-Islamic style, with the true arch). Strictly: the first Islamic tomb in India is Sultan Ghari (1231), built by Iltutmish for his son Nasiruddin Mahmud (app notes 1:115; ASI).
Balban's tomb (Mehrauli) is given as the first tomb in a purely Indo-Islamic style, being the first with a true arch. Humayun's tomb is Mughal; Aibak's tomb (Lahore) and Alauddin's tomb are not counted as the first.

s: Which among the following is ‘Octagonal tomb’?
x: Sikandar Lodi's tomb is octagonal (an arched verandah round the chamber) and has the first double dome. Balban's, Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq's and Firoz Shah's tombs are square.

s:
Match the following.
List I (Architectural Style)
List II (Associated Dynasty)

A. 'Lotus bud' fringe on the underside of the arch
1. Sharquis

B. Emergence of octagonal tomb
2. Vijayanagara

C. Use of Bodegoi in the pillar
3. Khiljis

D. Massive entrance gate with inclined walls
4. Tughluqs
Codes A B C D
x: Lotus-bud fringe on the arch = Khaljis (A-3, Alai Darwaza); octagonal tomb emerged under the Tughluqs (B-4, Khan-i-Jahan Tilangani); bodegai (bracket capital) = Vijayanagara (C-2); massive propylon gateways with inclined walls = Sharqis of Jaunpur (D-1, Atala Masjid). So 3 4 2 1.

s: Which sultan built Alai Darwaza?

s: Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque in Delhi was built by:
x: Qutbuddin Aibak built the Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque (completed 1198), the first mosque of the Turkish rulers in Delhi, from the material of 27 temples.

s: What is ‘Adhai Din ka Zhonpda’?
x: Adhai Din ka Jhonpra at Ajmer is a mosque built by Qutbuddin Aibak from temple material. It is not a temple, hut or tower.

s: Hauz-e-Sultani is a…
x: Hauz-i-Sultani (Hauz-i-Shamsi) at Mehrauli is a reservoir dug by Iltutmish; 'hauz' means a water tank.

s: The Qutab Minar was named after: merican
x:
Most books and keys: named after Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki. Some historians: named after its builder Qutbuddin Aibak (Wikipedia, citing ASI).
The Qutb Minar is commonly held to be named after the Sufi saint Khwaja Qutbuddin Bakhtiyar Kaki; it was begun by Qutbuddin Aibak and completed by Iltutmish. Iltutmish and Raziya are not its namesakes.

s: Who amongst the following sultans built the fifth storey of Qutub Minar?
x: Firoz Shah Tughlaq replaced the lightning-damaged top storey and added the fifth storey. Aibak built the first storey and Iltutmish the next three; Sikandar Lodi only repaired it.

s: Which one of the following monuments has a dome which is said to be one of the largest in the world?
x: The Gol Gumbaz (Bijapur), tomb of Muhammad Adil Shah, has one of the largest domes in the world (second only to St Peter's, Rome) and a whispering gallery.

s: What is the name of the 16th century stepwell that the Archaeological Survey of India recently conserved in collaboration with the World Monuments Fund India?
o: More than one of the above
x: Rajon ki Baoli, Mehrauli (c. 1506, Daulat Khan Lodi, reign of Sikandar Lodi) was conserved by the ASI with the World Monuments Fund India (TCS Foundation funding) and reopened in May 2025. Agrasen ki Baoli and Chauki Bavdi were not this project.
